# nico_ssh_key (Resource)

SSH Key is a public key that can be used to access the Serial Console of an Instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_ssh_key" "example" {
  ssh_key_group_id               = "ssh-key-group-id-uuid"
  name                           = "name-value"
  public_key                     = "public-key-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name cannot match that name an existing SSH Key
- `public_key` (String) Must be an SSH key of type: RSA, ECDSA or ED25519

### Optional

- `ssh_key_group_id` (String) ID of the SSH Key Group this key should be attached to
- `ssh_key_id` (String) Path parameter: ssh_key_id.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date/time when the SSH key was created
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint of the public key
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `org` (String) Organization the SSHKey belongs to
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the Tenant
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the SSH key was last updated
